examples.en: My grandmother makes delicious dumplings for Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在農曆新年會包好吃的餃子。

examples.en: We ordered a plate of steamed dumplings at the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市點了一盤蒸餃。

examples.en: Would you like soup or dumplings with your lunch set?
examples.zh: 你的午餐套餐想配湯還是餃子？

examples.en: Students will elect a new class leader on Friday.
examples.zh: 學生們星期五要選出新的班長。

examples.en: The members voted to elect Ms. Chen as club president.
examples.zh: 成員們投票選出陳小姐擔任社長。

examples.en: Citizens elect their mayor every four years in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市的市民每四年選一次市長。

examples.en: She looked at his new bike with envy.
examples.zh: 她羨慕地看著他的新腳踏車。

examples.en: Envy is a common feeling when friends get better grades.
examples.zh: 朋友成績比較好時，羨慕是很常見的感受。

examples.en: His success filled his classmates with envy.
examples.zh: 他的成功讓同學們心生嫉妒。

examples.en: I envy you because you can speak three languages.
examples.zh: 我很羨慕你，因為你會說三種語言。

examples.en: Many people envy her calm attitude toward work.
examples.zh: 許多人羨慕她面對工作的沉著態度。

examples.en: He does not envy his brother's busy schedule at all.
examples.zh: 他一點也不羨慕哥哥忙碌的行程。

examples.en: We had dinner at a fancy restaurant for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為了她的生日去一家高級餐廳吃晚餐。

examples.en: I do not need a fancy phone; a simple one is enough.
examples.zh: 我不需要花俏的手機，簡單的就夠了。

examples.en: She wore a fancy dress to her cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件華麗的洋裝去參加表姊的婚禮。

examples.en: Do you fancy a cup of tea after the long walk?
examples.zh: 走了這麼遠的路，你想不想喝杯茶？

examples.en: I fancy going to the beach this weekend.
examples.zh: 我這個週末想去海邊。

examples.en: She really fancies the red jacket in the shop window.
examples.zh: 她真的很喜歡櫥窗裡的那件紅外套。

examples.en: This jacket is very fashionable among teenagers right now.
examples.zh: 這件夾克現在在青少年之間非常流行。

examples.en: She always looks fashionable in her simple clothes.
examples.zh: 她穿著簡單的衣服，看起來總是很時髦。

examples.en: The cafe is a fashionable place for young office workers.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳是年輕上班族愛去的時髦地方。

examples.en: Please turn off the faucet while you brush your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙時請把水龍頭關上。

examples.en: The kitchen faucet is leaking again, so we need a plumber.
examples.zh: 廚房的水龍頭又漏水了，所以我們需要請水電工。

examples.en: Turn the faucet to the left to get hot water.
examples.zh: 把水龍頭往左轉就會出熱水。

examples.en: There is a white fence around the garden.
examples.zh: 花園周圍有一道白色的圍籬。

examples.en: The dog jumped over the fence and ran into the park.
examples.zh: 那隻狗跳過柵欄，跑進公園。

examples.en: Dad is painting the old wooden fence this weekend.
examples.zh: 爸爸這個週末要粉刷那道舊木頭圍籬。

examples.en: Bring a flashlight in case the power goes out.
examples.zh: 帶一支手電筒，以免停電。

examples.en: I used my flashlight to find the keys under the bed.
examples.zh: 我用手電筒找到床底下的鑰匙。

examples.en: The batteries in this flashlight are almost dead.
examples.zh: 這支手電筒的電池快沒電了。

examples.en: You need two cups of flour to make this cake.
examples.zh: 做這個蛋糕需要兩杯麵粉。

examples.en: Mom bought a big bag of flour at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 媽媽在超市買了一大袋麵粉。

examples.en: Mix the flour with eggs and milk to make the dough.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和雞蛋、牛奶混合，做成麵糰。

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school band.
examples.zh: 她在學校樂隊裡吹長笛。

examples.en: The sound of the flute made the room feel calm.
examples.zh: 長笛的聲音讓房間感覺很平靜。

examples.en: He has taken flute lessons since he was ten.
examples.zh: 他從十歲起就在上長笛課。

examples.en: Let me be frank with you about the price.
examples.zh: 讓我坦率地跟你談談價格的事。

examples.en: She gave a frank answer to the interviewer's question.
examples.zh: 她對面試官的問題給了坦率的回答。

examples.en: We had a frank talk about how to improve the team.
examples.zh: 我們針對如何改進團隊進行了一次坦誠的談話。

examples.en: Please put the ice cream back in the freezer.
examples.zh: 請把冰淇淋放回冷凍庫。

examples.en: There is plenty of frozen fish in the freezer.
examples.zh: 冷凍庫裡有很多冷凍魚。

examples.en: Our freezer stopped working during the hot summer.
examples.zh: 我們的冷凍櫃在炎熱的夏天故障了。

examples.en: The loud thunder frightened the little girl.
examples.zh: 響亮的雷聲嚇到了那個小女孩。

examples.en: Do not frighten the cat; it is very shy.
examples.zh: 別嚇那隻貓，牠很害羞。

examples.en: Stories about ghosts used to frighten me when I was young.
examples.zh: 小時候，鬼故事常常嚇到我。

examples.en: Dad parked the car in the garage before dinner.
examples.zh: 爸爸在晚餐前把車停進車庫。

examples.en: We keep our bicycles and tools in the garage.
examples.zh: 我們把腳踏車和工具放在車庫裡。

examples.en: I took my car to the garage to fix the brakes.
examples.zh: 我把車開到修車廠修理煞車。

examples.en: Geography is my favorite subject at school.
examples.zh: 地理是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a map in geography class.
examples.zh: 老師在地理課上給我們看了一張地圖。

examples.en: The geography of Taiwan includes high mountains and long coasts.
examples.zh: 台灣的地形包括高山和綿長的海岸。

examples.en: He waved his hand as a gesture of goodbye.
examples.zh: 他揮手作為道別的手勢。

examples.en: Giving up your seat is a kind gesture.
examples.zh: 讓座是一個親切的舉動。

examples.en: A thumbs-up gesture means good job in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，豎起大拇指的手勢表示做得好。

examples.en: The guide gestured toward the old temple with his hand.
examples.zh: 導遊用手朝那座老廟比了一下。

examples.en: She gestured for me to sit down next to her.
examples.zh: 她示意我坐到她旁邊。

examples.en: The waiter gestured to the empty table by the window.
examples.zh: 服務生比向窗邊的空桌。

examples.en: My father plays golf with his friends on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我爸爸星期天和朋友打高爾夫球。

examples.en: Golf is not as popular as baseball in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，高爾夫球不像棒球那麼受歡迎。

examples.en: He bought a new set of golf clubs for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他為自己的生日買了一套新的高爾夫球桿。

examples.en: The greedy boy ate all the cookies by himself.
examples.zh: 那個貪心的男孩自己把餅乾全吃光了。

examples.en: Do not be greedy; share the cake with your sister.
examples.zh: 別貪心，把蛋糕和你姊姊分著吃。

examples.en: The company was greedy and raised its prices again.
examples.zh: 那家公司很貪婪，又調漲了價格。

examples.en: Dad used a hammer to put the nail into the wall.
examples.zh: 爸爸用鐵鎚把釘子釘進牆裡。

examples.en: Please pass me the hammer from the toolbox.
examples.zh: 請把工具箱裡的鐵鎚遞給我。

examples.en: This hammer is much heavier than it looks, so be careful.
examples.zh: 這支鐵鎚比看起來重很多，所以要小心。

examples.en: He hammered the nail into the wooden board carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地把釘子敲進木板裡。

examples.en: Heavy rain hammered on the tin roof all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整晚猛敲著鐵皮屋頂。

examples.en: Workers hammered the fence posts into the ground.
examples.zh: 工人們把柵欄的柱子搥進地裡。

examples.en: She wiped away her tears with a clean handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她用一條乾淨的手帕擦去眼淚。

examples.en: Grandpa always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
examples.zh: 爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

examples.en: I gave my mother a silk handkerchief for her birthday.
examples.zh: 我送了媽媽一條絲質手帕當生日禮物。

examples.en: Please put your wet coat on a hanger to dry.
examples.zh: 請把你的濕外套掛在衣架上晾乾。

examples.en: I need more hangers for the clothes in my closet.
examples.zh: 我的衣櫃裡需要更多衣架來掛衣服。

examples.en: The shop gives you a plastic hanger with every shirt.
examples.zh: 這家店每買一件襯衫都會附一個塑膠衣架。

examples.en: Please turn on the heater; it is very cold in the room.
examples.zh: 請打開電暖器，房間裡很冷。

examples.en: We bought a new water heater for the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我們幫浴室買了一台新的熱水器。

examples.en: The old heater in the classroom makes a strange noise.
examples.zh: 教室裡那台舊暖氣機會發出奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: The restaurant plans to hire two new waiters next month.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳計畫下個月僱用兩名新服務生。

examples.en: We decided to hire a bus for the school trip.
examples.zh: 我們決定為校外教學租一輛巴士。

examples.en: They hired a tutor to help their son with math.
examples.zh: 他們聘請了一位家教幫兒子補數學。

examples.en: I felt homesick during my first week abroad.
examples.zh: 我出國的第一週覺得很想家。

examples.en: The new student was homesick and missed her family.
examples.zh: 那位新生很想家，想念她的家人。

examples.en: Are you homesick, or do you enjoy living in the dorm?
examples.zh: 你會想家嗎，還是你喜歡住宿舍？

examples.en: Honesty is the best policy, especially at work.
examples.zh: 誠實是上策，尤其是在工作上。

examples.en: I admire her honesty when she admits a mistake.
examples.zh: 我很欣賞她承認錯誤時的誠實。

examples.en: The teacher praised the boy for his honesty.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那個男孩的誠實。

examples.en: The weather was horrible, so we stayed home all day.
examples.zh: 天氣糟糕透了，所以我們整天待在家。

examples.en: I had a horrible dream about missing the final exam.
examples.zh: 我做了一個關於錯過期末考的可怕的夢。

examples.en: The soup tasted horrible, so I could not finish it.
examples.zh: 這碗湯的味道糟透了，所以我喝不完。

examples.en: Summers in Taipei are hot and humid.
examples.zh: 台北的夏天又熱又潮濕。

examples.en: The air feels very humid just before it starts to rain.
examples.zh: 下雨前，空氣感覺非常潮濕。

examples.en: Keep dried mushrooms in a cool place, away from humid air.
examples.zh: 乾香菇要放在涼爽的地方，遠離潮濕的空氣。

examples.en: Her sense of humor makes everyone in the class laugh.
examples.zh: 她的幽默感讓班上每個人都笑了。

examples.en: The movie has a lot of humor, so the kids enjoyed it.
examples.zh: 這部電影很幽默，所以孩子們很喜歡。

examples.en: He answered the difficult question with a little humor.
examples.zh: 他用一點幽默回答了那個困難的問題。

examples.en: The teacher gave a humorous speech at the graduation.
examples.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上發表了一場幽默的演講。

examples.en: I like this humorous story about a talking dog.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這個關於會說話的狗的幽默故事。

examples.en: His humorous way of talking makes meetings less boring.
examples.zh: 他幽默的說話方式讓會議沒那麼無聊。

examples.en: Hunger made it hard for him to focus in class.
examples.zh: 飢餓讓他在課堂上很難專心。

examples.en: Many charities around the world work to end hunger.
examples.zh: 世界各地有許多慈善團體致力於消除飢餓。

examples.en: She has a great hunger for knowledge and loves reading.
examples.zh: 她對知識有強烈的渴望，也愛閱讀。

examples.en: You can find more information on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到更多資訊。

examples.en: Could you give me some information about the trip?
examples.zh: 你可以給我一些關於這次旅行的資訊嗎？

examples.en: The information in this email is very useful.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件裡的資訊非常有用。

examples.en: She is an intelligent student who learns quickly.
examples.zh: 她是個學得很快的聰明學生。

examples.en: Dolphins are intelligent animals that can learn many tricks.
examples.zh: 海豚是很聰明的動物，能學會許多把戲。

examples.en: That was an intelligent decision to save money.
examples.zh: 存錢是個明智的決定。

examples.en: Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking.
examples.zh: 我在說話時請不要打斷我。

examples.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the manager wants to see you.
examples.zh: 抱歉打擾一下，經理想見你。

examples.en: A loud phone call interrupted our family dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一通很大聲的電話打斷了我們的家庭晚餐。

examples.en: Thomas Edison invented many useful machines during his life.
examples.zh: 愛迪生一生發明了許多有用的機器。

examples.en: The students invented a new game for the school party.
examples.zh: 學生們為學校派對創造了一個新遊戲。

examples.en: She invented an excuse to leave the meeting early.
examples.zh: 她編造了一個藉口提早離開會議。

examples.en: Thank you for the invitation to your birthday party.
examples.zh: 謝謝你邀請我參加你的生日派對。

examples.en: We sent all the wedding invitations to our friends last week.
examples.zh: 我們上週把所有婚禮邀請函都寄給朋友了。

examples.en: I received an invitation to speak at the school event.
examples.zh: 我收到了在校內活動演講的邀請。

examples.en: My uncle loves listening to jazz in the evening.
examples.zh: 我叔叔喜歡在晚上聽爵士樂。

examples.en: The cafe plays soft jazz on weekend afternoons.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡廳在週末下午播放輕柔的爵士樂。

examples.en: She joined the school jazz band last year.
examples.zh: 她去年加入了學校的爵士樂團。

examples.en: She felt jealous when her friend won the prize.
examples.zh: 朋友得獎時，她感到嫉妒。

examples.en: He is jealous of his brother's new bicycle.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒哥哥的新腳踏車。

examples.en: My dog gets jealous when I pet the cat.
examples.zh: 當我摸貓的時候，我的狗會吃醋。

examples.en: We rented a jeep to drive through the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們租了一輛吉普車開過山區。

examples.en: The old jeep climbed the muddy hill very slowly.
examples.zh: 那輛老吉普車非常緩慢地爬上泥濘的山坡。

examples.en: My uncle drives a green jeep to his farm.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開一輛綠色吉普車去他的農場。

examples.en: A kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
examples.zh: 袋鼠把牠的寶寶放在育兒袋裡。

examples.en: We saw a kangaroo jumping across the field at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻袋鼠跳過草地。

examples.en: Kangaroos live in Australia and mostly eat grass and leaves.
examples.zh: 袋鼠住在澳洲，主要吃草和樹葉。

examples.en: The school is only two kilometers from my house.
examples.zh: 學校離我家只有兩公里。

examples.en: He runs five kilometers every morning before work.
examples.zh: 他每天早上上班前跑五公里。

examples.en: How many kilometers is it from Taipei to Taichung?
examples.zh: 台北到台中有幾公里？

examples.en: My little sister goes to kindergarten every morning.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天早上去上幼稚園。

examples.en: The kindergarten teacher reads a story to the children.
examples.zh: 幼稚園老師念故事給孩子們聽。

examples.en: Most kids learn to write their names in kindergarten.
examples.zh: 大多數孩子在幼稚園學會寫自己的名字。

examples.en: The princess lived happily in a small kingdom by the sea.
examples.zh: 公主快樂地住在海邊的小王國裡。

examples.en: Long ago, a wise king ruled this kingdom.
examples.zh: 很久以前，一位睿智的國王統治著這個王國。

examples.en: In science class, we learned about the animal kingdom.
examples.zh: 在自然課上，我們學到了動物界。

examples.en: The koala slept in the tree for most of the day.
examples.zh: 無尾熊大半天都在樹上睡覺。

examples.en: Koalas mostly eat eucalyptus leaves and sleep up to twenty hours a day.
examples.zh: 無尾熊主要吃尤加利葉，一天最多睡二十小時。

examples.en: Many tourists want to hold a koala in Australia.
examples.zh: 許多遊客想在澳洲抱無尾熊。

examples.en: Please add some lettuce to my sandwich.
examples.zh: 請在我的三明治裡加一些生菜。

examples.en: The farmer grows lettuce and carrots behind his house.
examples.zh: 農夫在房子後面種生菜和紅蘿蔔。

examples.en: A fresh lettuce salad goes well with grilled fish.
examples.zh: 新鮮的生菜沙拉很適合搭配烤魚。

examples.en: The dog likes to lick my hand when I come home.
examples.zh: 我回家時，狗喜歡舔我的手。

examples.en: Do not lick your fingers; wash your hands first.
examples.zh: 不要舔手指，先去洗手。

examples.en: The child licked the ice cream before it melted.
examples.zh: 孩子在冰淇淋融化前舔了一口。

examples.en: We saw a flash of lightning over the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們看到山上有一道閃電。

examples.en: Lightning struck the tall tree behind the school.
examples.zh: 閃電擊中了學校後面那棵高大的樹。

examples.en: Stay away from open fields when there is lightning.
examples.zh: 有閃電時，要遠離空曠的田野。

examples.en: I bought a loaf of bread at the bakery.
examples.zh: 我在麵包店買了一條麵包。

examples.en: She cut the warm loaf into thick slices for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她把還溫熱的麵包切成厚片當早餐。

examples.en: This bakery sells a loaf of fresh bread for sixty dollars.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店一條新鮮麵包賣六十元。

examples.en: I cannot open the door because the lock is broken.
examples.zh: 門鎖壞了，所以我打不開門。

examples.en: Dad changed the lock on the front door last week.
examples.zh: 爸爸上週換了前門的鎖。

examples.en: This bike lock is strong enough to stop thieves.
examples.zh: 這個腳踏車鎖夠堅固，能擋住小偷。

examples.en: Please lock the door when you leave the office.
examples.zh: 離開辦公室時請鎖門。

examples.en: She locked her phone in the drawer before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前她把手機鎖在抽屜裡。

examples.en: He locked himself out of the house again.
examples.zh: 他又把自己鎖在屋外了。

examples.en: The loser of the game must buy drinks for everyone.
examples.zh: 比賽的輸家要請大家喝飲料。

examples.en: He is a good loser and always shakes hands with the winner.
examples.zh: 他輸得很有風度，總會和贏家握手。

examples.en: Do not call yourself a loser just because you failed once.
examples.zh: 別因為失敗一次就說自己是失敗者。

examples.en: The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
examples.zh: 魔術師從帽子裡拉出一隻兔子。

examples.en: The kids laughed when the magician made a coin disappear.
examples.zh: 魔術師讓硬幣消失時，孩子們都笑了。

examples.en: My cousin wants to become a magician when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我表弟長大後想成為魔術師。
